scope: public/F4M/new/ only; original game and presentation unchanged

tests.browser_context: Exact standalone HTML tested through offline set_content with real Blob Workers. Production publication verified via Netlify deploy metadata. Direct live HTTP and remote interactive browser checks were blocked by this environment and are not claimed.
tests.storage_context: Unavailable native storage handled safely; persistence roundtrip tested with an explicit memory Storage adapter, not real-origin navigation.

match.interpretation: Engineering smoke test only; not an Elo estimate or proof of superiority. Equal requested budgets, actual durations differ; legacy soft deadlines overshoot. Three of four pairs split by first player.

policy.dcc: Experimental root re-ranking within 12 evaluation points, same tactical-safety class, no mate override. Not the full research rDCC architecture.
policy.stronger_engine_claim: Not established by this small sample. Correctness defects and UI responsiveness independently tested.

preserved_rules: magnet order: top, bottom, left, right
settle then detect win/full then decay and change player
expired magnet releases at next settlement
simultaneous wins retain original top-left scan precedence
full board without a win is a draw
review_pack: Source, build script, deterministic tests, raw match logs, browser receipts and screenshots provided to BD separately.
